items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Because he used to date Linda(?), a girl who was one of my classmates.

ctx.x: And I knew him from Kansas City. Because he used to date Linda(?), a girl who was one of my classmates. So I just knew him well. I think it was him that influenced them to check me, to get me to play with the band. And I was only supposed to have the job six months. Because that's what Scotty got; he got six months.
Well, Lamar came to New York with the Missourians.
